## What the website includes

- A homepage introducing my education, skills, and career goals.
- A Quarto dashboard analyzing the Case 31 credit union survey.
- A page explaining CSS/SCSS with code and a styled example.
- A working Quarto listing with categorized project cards.

The Case 31 dashboard uses course case data in place of Culminating Experience project data. Source attribution, variable definitions, missing-data handling, and analysis limitations are provided on the dashboard.
